description:
BROE auctioneers are pleased to present 20 Saint John’s Avenue, Clondalkin, Dublin 22, to the market. This well maintained semi-detached property offers an excellent opportunity for buyers seeking a comfortable home in a mature and highly convenient residential area. The property has been well cared for over the years and benefits from a newly converted attic space, providing additional accommodation and versatility for modern family living. It is an ideal choice for anyone looking for more space to grow their family or establish themselves in a desirable location in Dublin 22. The interior living space is bright and airy throughout. Upon entering the ground floor, you are welcomed by a storm porch that leads into a bright entrance hallway. This area opens onto a spacious kitchen and dining area. The open-plan layout continues into a sitting room at the front of the property. The kitchen and dining room open up to a beautifully landscaped, low-maintenance rear garden, perfect for summer evenings. The garden also benefits from a large shed equipped with electricity and plumbing. The first floor features three generously sized bedrooms along with a family bathroom. Last year, the attic was converted to create an additional room that includes an ensuite bathroom.  To the front of the property, there is a low-maintenance driveway with ample parking, ideally situated at the end of a small cul-de-sac in this highly sought-after development. The property also benefits from the significant advantage of being offered for sale with no onward chain, allowing for a smoother and potentially quicker purchase. Saint John’s Avenue is a well-established and highly regarded residential development, conveniently located close to a wide range of local amenities. Clondalkin Village, schools, shops, parks, leisure facilities, and public transport links are all within easy reach, while the M50 & N7 motorways provide excellent access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. This property is expected to attract significant interest, so early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate this stunning home. 

To register your interest, please contact Shauna O’Brien of BROE auctioneers today.
